OpenAI is setting money on fire as it arranges the pieces for what we think is a pre-bailout 'bailout plan,' including passing costs on to American taxpayers. We talk through Ed Zitron's work on OpenAI's financials, our own compilation of OpenAI's shady history and moves, and the ChatGPT maker's greed. As part of this, we talk about NVIDIA and Jensen Huang's relationship with OpenAI and Sam Altman.
